title: Brick Kart
description: A Mario Kart-style racer built from LEGO-style bricks: 17 big maps in 5 cups, including a Movie Cup with Jurassic World, Star Wars, Marvel and Harry Potter tracks and a JJK Run cup with a Jujutsu Kaisen map for every season up to the Culling Games, all full of brick-built characters, plus a Use Characters option that puts 83 movie characters (now including Harry Potter, with Wizarding Rides karts) behind the wheel with Mario Kart-style cheers, taunts and tricks. Gliders, hazards, 16 racers with 12 per race, 23 power-ups plus 14 movie powers, drifting mini-turbos, and 1-8 player split-screen with controller support.
